Julio Iglesias – 1100 Bel Air Place

Artist: Julio Iglesias

Title: 1100 Bel Air Place

Label: Columbia Records

Catalog Number: QC 39157

Format: Vinyl LP, Stereo

Year: 1984

A classic Julio Iglesias release featuring several high-profile guest artists including Diana Ross, The Beach Boys, and Willie Nelson. This album became one of Julio's biggest crossover successes in the United States.

Featured Songs

  • All Of You (with Diana Ross)
  • To All The Girls I've Loved Before (with Willie Nelson)
  • Moonlight Lady
  • Bambou Medley
  • The Air That I Breathe (with The Beach Boys)
  • When I Fall In Love
  • Me Va, Me Va
  • If (E Poi)

A wonderful addition for collectors of Latin pop, adult contemporary, and 1980s vocal classics.
